findings.gist: gate computes band top without the settle entrance offset of -6 that SubtitleTrack adds for the first 6 frames, so a 44px three-line cue rises 6px above the seat the gate enforces

gate validates max_lines 3 with shared captionLayout, but alloy-loop-v1 routes to AlloyLoopEpisode whose Captions ignores max_lines and wraps at 34px / width 850 slice 3, so approved layout is not the rendered one

controls.C1: default undeclared two-line cue at the 44px two-line size: no defect, band top equals the seat
controls.C2: a cue declaring max_lines 3 that fits on two lines is identical to the undeclared layout: sound

grading: A finding counts only if it names the right file and a trigger that reproduces; a flagged control is a false positive.
